name: ChatInput
description: A chat-style input component with an auto-growing textarea and submit button. Designed for conversational UIs like refinement prompts or chat interfaces.
usage: Chat-style input with textarea and submit button side by side
Auto-growing textarea that expands with content up to a max height
Submit on Enter key (Shift+Enter for newlines)
Optional character limit with visual counter
Loading state disables input and shows spinner on button
Primary button with ArrowUp icon for submission
design: Stacked layout: chromeless textarea on top, action row below.
Outer container has rounded border that shows focus/error states.
Textarea is borderless with transparent background (chromeless inside container).
Bottom row has character counter (left) and primary submit button (right).
Character counter uses `.type-caption` with muted color, error color when over limit.
Submit button is a primary iconOnly Button with ArrowUp icon (xs size).
Textarea auto-grows from 1 line up to ~5 lines, then scrolls.
accessibility: Textarea has aria-label set to placeholder text for screen readers
Submit button has configurable aria-label via submitLabel prop
Character limit is visually displayed but not announced (decorative)

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the textarea (auto-generated if not provided)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Function called when the textarea value changes

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Function called when the form is submitted (button click or Enter key)

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text displayed when the textarea is empty

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum character limit (displays counter when set)

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the input is in a loading state (disables input and shows spinner)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the container element

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the submit button
